title: 第17章 败叶雷第18章 优秀得有点夸张
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
叶雷显得十分冷酷，一步步登上擂台，站在叶云飞的对面。
叶雷面如冠玉，长得有几分俊美，负手而立，乜斜看着叶云飞，眼神中有一种轻世傲物的神采。
“你竟敢伤害我弟，这让我很生气。
我生气的后果，很严重。”
叶雷开口说话，给人一种居高临下的感觉。
“我发现，你们两兄弟，都一个德性，特别能装。
刚才，叶强也是这么装的。
结果，他现在还没有醒过来。”
叶云飞无奈地摇了摇头。
叶雷闻言，脸色一沉，目光变得阴冷起来，杀机毫不掩饰。
擂台四周，众人也是屏气静息，紧张地盯着擂台之上。
叶雷大部分的时间都在潜修，这两年来，叶家的人，很少有机会能看到他亲自出手。
这一刻，大家都有点期待。
想看看，叶雷的战力，到底强到了什么地步！
“叶云飞，你说，如果我在这个擂台之上，把你废了。
让你再一次，成为一个无法修武的废物，那该多有趣呢。”
叶雷突然压低声音，用只有他和叶云飞两个人之间，才能听得到的音量，低声说话。
他的语气，显得十分狠毒。
“说不定，是我废了你呢。”
叶云飞面无表情，淡淡说道。

“就凭你？
你先看看我们之间的差距吧！”
叶雷的脸色，突然变得狰狞了起来。
轰！
一股强大的灵力气流猛然自他体内，溢了出来。
“炼体九重！”
整个演武场，一片惊呼。
“叶雷少爷，突破到炼体九重了！”
“炼体九重，在整个圆月城的年轻一代之中，绝对是数一数二的实力！”
……
全场轰动，所有的族人，都是十分震惊。
“哈哈，雷儿好样的！
这意味着，我们叶家的子弟，正式踏入圆月城年轻一代的最强者行列。
秦家的秦安，虽然觉醒了天灵体，但是想来，秦安现在的境界，大概也就是炼体九重了吧。
相比之下，我们叶家的子弟，并不逊色多少啊！”
content_en:
Ye Lei looked very cold, stepping onto the ring step by step and standing opposite Ye Yunfei.
Ye Lei's face was like a jade, and he was somewhat handsome. He stood with his hands behind his back and looked at Ye Yunfei sideways, with a look of contempt and arrogance in his eyes.
“You dare to hurt my brother and that makes me angry.
The consequences of my anger are serious. "
When Ye Lei spoke, he felt condescending.
"I discovered that you two brothers have the same virtue, and you are particularly good at pretending.
Just now, Ye Qiang was pretending like this.
As a result, he hasn't woken up yet. "
Ye Yunfei shook his head helplessly.
When Ye Lei heard this, his face darkened, his eyes became cold, and his murderous intent was not concealed.
Around the ring, everyone held their breath and stared nervously at the ring.
Ye Lei spends most of his time cultivating in secret. In the past two years, people in the Ye family have rarely had the opportunity to see him take action in person.
Everyone is looking forward to this moment.
I want to see how strong Ye Lei's combat power is!
"Ye Yunfei, you said, if I were on this stage, I would destroy you.
How interesting it would be to let you once again become a useless person who cannot practice martial arts. "
Ye Lei suddenly lowered his voice and spoke in a low voice at a volume that only he and Ye Yunfei could hear.
His tone seemed very vicious.
"Maybe I was the one who destroyed you."
Ye Yunfei said calmly with no expression on his face.
"Just you?
You first look at the gap between us! "
Ye Lei's expression suddenly became ferocious.
boom!
A powerful flow of spiritual energy suddenly overflowed from his body.
"Ninth level of body refining!"
The entire martial arts arena was filled with exclamations of surprise.
"Master Ye Lei, you have broken through to the ninth level of body refining!"
"The ninth level of body refining is definitely one of the best among the younger generation in the entire Yuanyue City!"
…
There was a sensation in the whole place, and all the tribesmen were very shocked.
"Haha, well done Lei'er!
This means that we, the children of the Ye family, have officially entered the ranks of the strongest of the younger generation in Yuanyue City.
Although Qin An of the Qin family has awakened his Heavenly Spirit Body, thinking about it, Qin An's current state is probably at the ninth level of body refining.
In comparison, our children of the Ye family are not much inferior! "
